title: First Date
descriptionHtml:
This beauty will help make your night last forever.
Consisting of Dahlias, Dianthus, Celosia, Madame Butterfly Snapdragons, and Veronica.

title: Sex and Candy
descriptionHtml: You’re sure to get at least one of those if you give her this breathtaking bouquet consisting of Celosia, Madame Butterfly Snapdragons, Lisianthus, and Pink Pearl Dahlias.

title: Volcano Girl
descriptionHtml: This bouquet really can’t be beat. She consists of Chedi Orange Marigolds, Celosia, and Sea Holly.

title: Sugar Town
descriptionHtml: All your troubles will pass while gazing at this sweet bouquet consisting of White Swan Marigolds and Celosia.

title: Sorry My Dog Bit You
descriptionHtml: Try to avoid a lawsuit by gifting them this friendly bouquet consisting of Chedi Orange Marigolds, Celosia, and a single Procut Plum Sunflower.

title: Here Comes the Sun
descriptionHtml:
There will always be sun where this bouquet is concerned.

Consisting of Celosia, Chedi Orange Marigolds, Veronica, and a Procut Plum Sunflower.

title: Candy Says
descriptionHtml: Candy says I hate the big decisions, so make it easy and decide on this bouquet consisting Lisianthus, Madame Butterfly Snapdragons, and Celosia.
